documents.description: Epic anchor for Initiative A of the onboarding pain-point audit (guerrilla paper barkpark-onboarding-painpoint-audit-2026-07-13). Make Barkpark onboarding ONE explicit transaction that emits ONE trustworthy receipt (instance ID, team, URL+aliases, auth tier, MCP tool-catalog version+names, read-only call result, exact client-reload instruction; never prints the bearer). A first-time Windows user goes nothing to authenticated to MCP-connected to correct-team instance with a read-only tool call proven, under 5 min. Charter: .claude/workflows/bp-onboarding-composition-charter.md. Wave 1 slices are children of this task.

purpose.endgame: A first-time Windows user completes setup in under five minutes and receives one receipt proving identity, scope, MCP tool catalog, read-only access, and the exact reload action.
purpose.impact: Blocks adoption because authentication, team selection, instance identity, MCP catalog state, and client reload instructions can currently diverge or leave the user unsure what actually worked.

importance.reason: This is the first product journey; ambiguity here prevents users from reaching any downstream Barkpark value.

proof.evidence: The description enumerates instance ID, team, URL aliases, auth tier, MCP catalog version and names, read-only result, and reload instruction while forbidding bearer output.

proof.claim: The journey has a user-level gate
proof.evidence: The first criterion requires a new user to reach authenticated, correctly scoped MCP operation in under five minutes via the doctor receipt.
No parent_id is recorded; this task is a root mission named Barkpark adoption mission — a new user reaches a trustworthy working agent connection without assembling hidden setup steps.

relevance.reason: The open P0 epic owns the current onboarding pain-point initiative and its Wave 1 children.

purpose.statement: Collapse first-run setup into one identity transaction and one non-secret receipt that proves the user reached the correct Barkpark and can make a read-only MCP call.
purpose.why:
The larger onboarding goal is not account creation alone; it is a verified path from nothing to a correctly scoped tool call. This epic composes the scattered identity and connection facts into one transaction and receipt, giving users and support a shared, bearer-free proof instead of several individually successful steps that may point at different instances or teams.

If omitted, the larger goal cannot truthfully claim this endgame: A first-time Windows user completes setup in under five minutes and receives one receipt proving identity, scope, MCP tool catalog, read-only access, and the exact reload action.
